messages:
rachael (marketing): Heads-up: registration is live for the Apr benchmark webinar. Need a 15m smoke today to validate Zoom recording, SRT captions ingestion, S3 copy, and HubSpot lead routing. anyone available?

tomas (growth): available for 16:30 PT. main points: utm params on confirmation link, explicit opt-in checkbox for clip reuse, and campaign tagging so nurture flows split correctly.

mike (events-ops): I'll own the Zoom side. Proposed config: cloud recording ON, record active speaker + shared screen, auto-transcript OFF (we ingest vendor SRT), alt host enabled. S3 path: s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-benchmark/. retention 90d, vault copy to long-term for edits.

sara (content): I'll curate 3 timestamps during the event for a 60s highlight and prepare alt text. owning clip selection.

devin (analytics): HubSpot needs: registrant webhook -> /integrations/hubspot/webinar; payload includes utm_source, utm_campaign, session_id. Add custom property webinar_segment=benchmark_apr and hs_event_watch_time. Routing rule: attendee=yes AND watch_time>=300s -> sales-touch-1 else -> nurture-demo-sequence.

mike (events-ops): Runbook snippet for recording notification: 
```
POST /recordings/notify
{ "meeting_id": "{{meetingId}}", "recording_url": "{{downloadUrl}}" }
```
Zapier lambda will copy recording to S3 and then ping captions vendor.

rachael (marketing): Legal asked explicitly for consent checkbox copy. Draft: "I consent to receive post-event materials, recordings, and related marketing." Tomas pls confirm.

tomas (growth): fine by me. also add vendor transcript opt-in mention.

mike (events-ops): Vendor timeline: draft SRT in 6-8h, human-checked final in 24h. 60s highlight editable within 12h. I'll add vendor webhook and creds to the secure runbook.

sara (content): Post-event email: short CTA, 60s clip, full transcript link, and CTA to request a demo. I'll stage copy and assets.

devin (analytics): Smoke steps for 16:30 PT:
- join as host & alt host
- start/stop recording
- confirm cloud recording appears
- webhook fires -> S3 object created (check md5)
- vendor receives notify and returns SRT to vendor endpoint
- HubSpot receives registrant + UTM properties
I'll paste the HubSpot workflow ID after smoke.

mike (events-ops): I'll run the smoke and paste logs here. fallback plan = manual download + upload if automation fails.

zoom-bot: Cloud recording for meeting 987-654-321 started at 2026-04-15T16:30:12Z.

rachael (marketing): Thanks all. If smoke is green, we send the confirmation email to registrants. mike drop runbook link after tests and devin add workflow ID. :thumbsup:
